criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Inquiries related to account creation, deletion, and personal information updates.

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Questions regarding card functionality, loss, theft, or damage.

categories.name: Transaction Problems
categories.definition: Concerns about failed, pending, or erroneous transactions.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees associated with transactions, card usage, or services.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions regarding the process and requirements for verifying identity.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Concerns related to adding funds to accounts or cards.

categories.name: Exchange Rates
categories.definition: Inquiries about current exchange rates and related fees.

categories.name: Refund Requests
categories.definition: Requests for refunds on transactions or purchases.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered while using ATMs, including card retrieval and cash withdrawal.

categories.name: Transfer Inquiries
categories.definition: Questions about sending or receiving money transfers.

categories.name: Virtual Card Queries
categories.definition: Inquiries specifically about virtual cards and their usage.

categories.name: Security Concerns
categories.definition: Reports of unauthorized transactions or compromised accounts.

categories.name: PIN and Passcode Issues
categories.definition: Questions related to PIN management and passcode recovery.

categories.name: Service Feedback
categories.definition: Customer feedback regarding dissatisfaction with services or products.

categories.name: General Inquiries
categories.definition: Miscellaneous questions that do not fit into other categories.
